mrd.text: Bosh is a golem whom Slobad repairs, and he joins Glissa and Slobad, who arrive in Medev and win Bruenna's help in reaching the Pool of Knowledge.
Along the way Bosh sacrifices himself to save his friends at the Krark-Clan hideout and is later partly reassembled by Slobad, and Glissa drinks the serum to free him from a quicksilver beast.
The group defeats the necromancer Geth at Ish Sah and learns that Memnarch is responsible for the attacks.
When Memnarch takes control of the Kaldra avatar and it betrays the group, Bosh stays behind and gives his life so his friends can escape.
